scope: Read-only review of skipping flush_once before its busy claim when the owned wire is empty and nghttp2_session_want_write returns zero.

terminal_counterexample.kind: Source-level reachable state; not reproduced by a runtime experiment.
terminal_counterexample.want_write: nghttp2_session.c:7152-7169 returns zero unconditionally after GOAWAY_TERM_SENT, even if active or queued outbound items remain.
terminal_counterexample.mem_send: mem_send_internal:2826-3122 has no equivalent terminal early return. It can finish active-item cleanup and process queued frames. A rejected queued request HEADERS can cause stream closure and its callback through preparation failure handling at2884-2906.
terminal_counterexample.example: A terminating GOAWAY takes priority over an already queued outgoing request. GOAWAY completion at2655-2673 closes selected incoming streams; it does not establish that every queued outgoing request has been retired.
terminal_counterexample.hyle_boundary: Native termination at216-249 can return success while queuing GOAWAY. Hyle on_frame_send records the GOAWAY wire epoch without automatically setting fatal_status, so current Hyle cannot exclude this state before the proposed guard.
terminal_counterexample.interpretation: Native documentation says a terminal connection should be dropped. That does not prove that skipping the current mem_send call preserves its cleanup, callback and error-discovery behavior. This review does not claim a newly reproduced Hyle failure.

preface.native_boundary: Client initialization at635-638 can have SEND_CLIENT_MAGIC with no active item; want_write can be zero although mem_send still returns the24-byte preface at3101-3118.
preface.current_hyle_exclusion: Successful Hyle session initialization always queues initial SETTINGS before exposing the session (http2.cc:997-1010), so this generic native counterexample is excluded by current initialization.

checked_states: Outside termination and initial client magic, an idle POP_ITEM state with want_write zero matches the no-item conditions of pop_next_ob_item at2328-2359.
NO_COPY PAUSE executes after_frame_sent1 and after_frame_sent2 before returning zero at3084-3096. An already populated Hyle owned wire must still flush regardless of native want_write.
User-deferred DATA is removed from the scheduler at915-935 and resumed through7649-7664. A connection-window block prevents native DATA selection too.
A first stream-window-blocked DATA item remains visible until native preparation establishes deferral at1996-2023; want_write is nonzero, so the proposed check would not skip that preparation.
Queued invalid urgent/regular frames keep want_write nonzero outside its terminal override. Concurrent-stream-limited request HEADERS are skipped by both want_write and native item selection.

complexity.want_write: Three constant-time queue-head checks, an active-item check, fixed settings/counter comparisons and at most eight urgency-queue empty checks. No traversal proportional to stream count.
complexity.source: session_sched_empty at957-966; outbound_queue_top is the head macro atnghttp2_outbound_item.h:192; pq_empty checks length atnghttp2_pq.c:150.
complexity.limit: An ordinary empty mem_send already performs bounded queue selection. A precheck could avoid some constant bookkeeping but also repeats checks on productive calls. No call-frequency, instruction, allocation or timing evidence establishes a material bottleneck.

decision: Reject the bare want_write fastpath: zero does not universally prove absence of native side effects, and no algorithmic scan is removed.
